name: lewm-proposal-cma-pilot-20261030-v1
purpose: Prospective bounded development pilot of persistent proposal weights

search.optimizer: diagonal CMA-ES, cma 4.4.4; maximize declared panel fitness

training.common_random_numbers: Every candidate and native in a generation uses the same two cases and planner seed. Candidate order preseeded; native first on even generations and last on odd generations.

selection.elite_rule: Best evaluated training candidate, ties earliest generation then candidate index; never unconditionally export final CMA mean.
selection.winner_rule: Highest two-case panel fitness; exact ties prefer native, then initial, then elite. Freeze selection receipt and weights before validation.

validation.rule: Native and selected arm on each case; alternate arm order. No reselection from validation.

fitness: If any panel violation: -1000000 - number of violation episodes. Otherwise (n+1)*safe_completion_count + sum(safe_progress) - 0.001*capped_action_sum/(n*150). Successful episodes use actual actions, unfinished use 150. Completion dominates bounded progress; violations cannot be traded for task reward.
progress_feedback: Safe completion=1; unsafe or technical invalid=0; safe unfinished=clip(1-final_error/initial_error,0,1). Error=norm(goal[:4]-state[:4])/20 + shortest angular error/(pi/9). This uses privileged simulator task state for scalar training feedback, never as an adapter input. Future optimizer controls require the same information.
injection: One adapter candidate occupies the final existing candidate slot in each CEM iteration; ordinary candidates remain. Same nominal search prediction work.
accounting: Charge every attempted reset, action, dense physics step, all candidates including discarded ones and frozen-model queries. Software synthetic tests separate. Record all errors and refusals; no outcome retries. Environment seeding is isolated from CMA random state.
stopping: Fixed schedule, no efficacy stopping. Before each new job retain 10 minutes to cutoff for preservation. Technical error stops for diagnosis, incomplete saved jobs cannot rerun automatically; retain new source versions for repairs. Hard one-hour provider cutoff; no extension or extra rental.
admission: Known source pair and three previously used geometries; require settled native full-pusher and arena clearance >=6px before any command. No physics or policy-input hazard overlay.
limitations: One reused task scene, three known virtual-hazard layouts and one optimizer seed. Reserved planner seeds are within-run validation, not previously unseen tasks or scene generalization.

This is a development CMA pilot, with contemporary native and untrained controls. Parameter random search, tuned fixed and ordinary-learning controls have not run, so no evolution-specific advantage claim is supported.
Learned native-proprioception motion safety and frozen LeWM task model remain unchanged; empirical calibration is not a universal safety guarantee.
authorization: User authorized proceeding from the completed single-episode integration test to the bounded evolutionary pilot; fresh $1 cap and one-hour cutoff. No historical allocation inherited.
